bbIndex.pathDescription: Project-relative file (reindex only that file) or directory (incremental index of changed files); for mode=post, the project whose derived phases should be re-run. REQUIRED in every mode, and for mode=post it is checked rather than ignored. Must resolve INSIDE the project: both sides are resolved through realpath, so a symlink inside the project pointing out of it is refused too.
